title: What to Expect This Election: OC Registrar Bob Page Explains on Inside the Issues with Amrit Singh
description:
Orange County Registrar of Voters Bob Page speaks with Amrit Singh on Spectrum News 1’s Inside the Issues about the upcoming election. Learn about voting deadlines, ballot options, election security, and what Orange County voters need to know before heading to the polls.
